# Review - PR 409 @ 1b4ebac083edbdf31c4022f3214e475b97241e85

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 135c6fdc08b0d58c38699348b118bc26cdc43e55. Small additive change: one new 151-line module `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/PointSelfConsistency.lean` (four public declarations, one private helper) plus one re-export import line in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean`.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/PointSelfConsistency.lean:31 - `avgOver_mix_noFinite` restates, statement and proof verbatim, the existing public `MIPStarRE.QPBT.avgOver_mix` at MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/RestrictedAverage.lean:60 (same namespace, same `[DecidableEq α]`-only hypotheses, same `Finset.sum_subset` proof); AGENTS.md "Proof Engineering / Search before proving" admits a file-local helper only when it genuinely reduces duplication. I confirmed `MIPStarRE.QPBT.avgOver_mix` is not reachable from this module's current imports, so the copy is not a name-clash workaround. Fix: import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.RestrictedAverage` (acyclic - only `Combining/Lines.lean` imports the new module) and delete the private copy, or hoist `avgOver_mix` into a lower module both files import.
- [ ] F2 (code; minor) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/PointSelfConsistency.lean:19 - the paper locator "lines 936--941", repeated at :84 and :99 for the uniform point marginals and the sampling transport, does not contain the cited content: `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-941` is the `fact:agreement` / `fact:data-processing` paragraph and `eq:pasting-q1`. The independent line-point sampling is stated at line 931 ("on average over ... sampled independently from the line-point distribution"), and the independent uniform lines again at 960-961. AGENTS.md "Documentation" requires the paper anchor to be the passage that supports the statement. Fix: cite 931-935 (optionally plus 960-961) for the sampling and marginal step, keeping 955-963 for the pasting use and 693-697 for `eq:qld-q-self-cons`.
- [ ] F3 (code; minor) PR 409 base branch `issue-388-combined-point-producer` - that branch's own pull request is already merged and its tip 8c401506a3a84c5f7f612ae67c2e5af36a6f0ffa is an ancestor of `github/main`, so merging PR 409 as currently targeted would land these commits on a stale branch rather than on main, and the GitHub file list for the PR shows 50+ unrelated already-merged files. Fix: retarget the base to `main` (the main-relative delta is exactly the two files above) before the merge gate runs.

## Review

Base used. The PR base is not main, and its tip is already contained in `github/main`, so I read the PR's own change against the main merge base `b3b84fbb8eeb0296ca493ad34e945a66a594e2c3`; against the stack base `8c401506` the diff additionally carries telemetry and the already-merged work of the two intervening pull requests. Trusted persona, protocol, CONTRIBUTING section 5 and AGENTS.md were read from `github/main` at 135c6fdc08b0d58c38699348b118bc26cdc43e55, never from the branch. The worktree HEAD equals the published head, so all checks are at `1b4ebac0`.

Faithfulness. `CombinedPointsWitness.self_consistency_defect_le` (:62) converts the witness field `self_consistent` (an `opFamilyDistSq` bound) into the consistency-defect convention through the existing `consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective`, using the witness's own projectivity - exactly the paper's step "Since the ... are projective ... by Fact~\ref{fact:agreement}" (14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-937) applied to `eq:qld-q-self-cons` (:693-697, `lem:qld-4-10` item 1). The error parameter stays `δQ`, the average stays over uniformly random `(x,z)`, and the only hypothesis added is `p1.IsOpposite p2`, which selects the opposite placements the paper's registers denote; no bridge, residual, repair or assumption bundle is introduced, and nothing is weakened to make the proof go through.

Transport. `avgOver_linePointDist_point` (:86) and `avgOver_prod_linePointDist_points` (:100) are exact equalities, not inequalities, and reuse main's `aLinePointDist_point_marginal_uniform` / `dLinePointDist_point_marginal_uniform` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean:118,167), `SandwichProduct.avgOver_distribution_prod` and `avgOver_uniform_prod`. `self_consistency_linePoint_defect_le` (:128) then takes the x-point from the first sample and the z-point from the second, which is what the paper's "sampled independently from the line-point distribution" requires for the `eq:pasting-2` hypothesis at :955-963; the bound stays `δQ`.

Proof integrity. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or `decide` occurs in the new module. `#print axioms` for all four public declarations, run with `lake env lean` against the worktree at this head, returns only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. No anti-pattern from `docs/anti_patterns.md` applies: the hypotheses are not conclusion-shaped, there is no `:= rfl` sleight, no zero fallback, no default witness, and every step bottoms out in existing project or Mathlib API.

Prior feedback. The only earlier marked review on this PR is at head `4e3bcf57` and lists no findings, so there was nothing unresolved to carry forward; the head has since moved only by merging main and adding the re-export import line.

CI. At this exact head `local-ci/summary` is success with all eight gating steps green (build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, paper-gaps, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin). `local-review/summary` is failure solely because a previous reviewer run exited 143 without publishing a review at this head.

Style. 151 lines, every line within 100 characters, module docstring with title and references, docstring on each public declaration, snake_case theorem names, imports one per line.

Not checked. I did not run a full `lake build` (I relied on the green `local-ci/build` at this head) and did not independently re-derive blueprint synchronization beyond the green `local-ci/blueprint-sync`. Prose is n/a: the main-relative change touches no blueprint TeX, docs, audit or paper-gap file.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=n/a)
